messages.subject: Project Quartz - engagement & NDA
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to catch up yesterday. As discussed, we'd like Whitfield Carter to act for us on the proposed acquisition of Whitmore Thermal Components (Sheffield-based thermal/cold-plate manufacturer). Internal codename Project Quartz.

Can you get a mutual NDA over to them to open the data room? Their MD is Geoffrey Whitmore; sell-side is Ashworth Quinn (Eleanor Bartlett).

Eleanor

messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor,

Delighted to act. Engagement letter to follow from Donna. James Osei will lead day-to-day with Elena Marchetti.

Draft mutual NDA attached - happy to send to Ashworth Quinn on your nod. Two-year term, 12-month non-solicit, standard carve-outs.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
